details.description: Grok 4.20 is a chat model from xAI, whose API docs now brand the company SpaceXAI, released on the xAI API on March 10, 2026. This id is a legacy alias: xAI's model registry lists it among the aliases for the endpoint it now documents as grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, the non-reasoning variant of Grok 4.20 that answers directly without an extended reasoning step. It accepts text and image input and produces text output, and supports function calling and structured outputs. A separate grok-4.20-0309-reasoning variant of the same model family adds a reasoning step before answering. Artificial Analysis, an independent benchmark, marks this variant ('Grok 4.20 0309 v2 (Non-reasoning)') deprecated in favor of xAI's newer Grok 4.3, though it remains live and priced on xAI's current models page as of September 2026.
advantages: Accepts both text and image input over a 1,000,000-token context window, per xAI's model documentation.
Supports native function calling and structured outputs for tool-use and agentic workflows, per xAI's documentation.
Answers directly without an extended reasoning step, per xAI's documentation, for lower latency than the reasoning variant of the same model.
disadvantages: Does not use an extended reasoning step before answering, per xAI's documentation, unlike the grok-4.20-0309-reasoning variant of the same model.
Artificial Analysis marks this variant (Grok 4.20 0309 v2 Non-reasoning) deprecated, naming xAI's Grok 4.3 as a newer alternative.
No longer listed in xAI's current Reasoning-capability comparison table, which covers grok-4.5, grok-4.6, grok-4.7 and grok-4.20-multi-agent.
use_cases: Lower-latency chat responses where an extended reasoning step is not needed
Agentic workflows that call external tools or functions
Tasks that combine image and text input, such as visual question answering

sources.title: Grok 4.20 0309 v2 (Non-reasoning) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis

notes: This slug does not have its own maker page; it is a legacy alias name in xAI's model registry that resolves to the same canonical model documented as grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning. The catalog's 1,000,000-token context window matches xAI's own docs, but Artificial Analysis' page for this model states a 2,000,000-token context window; the catalog figure was kept as authoritative. xAI's own per-model page repeats unattributed superlatives ('industry-leading speed', 'lowest hallucination rate on the market') that were left out per the no-unattributed-marketing rule, and also lists a 'Reasoning' capability badge that contradicts this variant's name and its registry data (no reasoning flag), so it was not relied on.
